summary: A correct, well-built list that NFL fans will clear, but Frank Gore, Curtis Martin and Bettis are not names a general player knows. Good for random play, not a daily.
reasons: Casual found the famous five (Smith, Payton, Sanders, Peterson, Henry) plus Tomlinson, then lost lives on Jim Brown, O. J. Simpson and Marshawn Lynch; current stars like Barkley and McCaffrey are not in the pool at all.
Near misses are fair and teach something (Dorsett #11, Jim Brown #12).
Only 32 scoring answers, all 10,000+ yard rushers, so a casual Blitz runs dry fast.
fixes: Drop junk aliases 'Emmitt III Smith' (Emmitt Smith) and 'Jerome Bettis Day' (Jerome Bettis).
